item.title: Worker injured in fire at fireworks workshop in Andiambalama

item.title: Narcotics, firearm and forged number plates seized following interrogation of female suspect
item.description: A stock of narcotics, a firearm and several forged vehicle number plates have been uncovered by officers attached to the Mount Lavinia Police based on information revealed during the interrogation of a detained female suspect. MORE..

item.title: 24 deaths by drowning so far this year – Police

item.title: JVP delegation discusses tourism, cultural ties with Kerala Chief Minister
item.description: The JVP delegation, led by its General Secretary Tilvin Silva, which is currently in India met Chief Minister of Kerala Pinarayi Vijayan on Wednesday to discuss measures to boost tourism and strengthen cultural ties. MORE..

item.title: Police warn of circulation of emails using name of CID Director
item.description: It has come to the attention of the authorities that an individual or group is currently circulating a fraudulent email to the general public, falsely claiming to be from the Director of the Criminal Investigation Department (CID), Shani Abeysekara, the Police Media Division said in a statement. MORE..

item.title: Bus drivers, conductors arrested while being under the influence of drugs in Piliyandala
